data.name: Crimson Circuit
data.detailed_description:
Survive the endless onslaught, conquer colossal bosses, and climb the leaderboard in this fast-paced third-person roguelike shooter.

You spawn into a procedurally generated gauntlet filled with relentless enemies, deadly traps, and powerful bosses. Each level demands you clear the arena before advancing, but survival isn’t just about skill—you’ll need to choose your upgrades wisely.

  • Fight Through Procedural Arenas

    Every run is unique. Enemies spawn in unpredictable patterns, forcing you to adapt and stay sharp.

  • Unlock Permanent Upgrades

    Spend coins at altars to strengthen your health, damage, and abilities. Even when a run ends, your progress carries forward.

  • Fast-Paced Combat

    Dash, dodge, and blast through enemies with your rapid-fire laser gun. Collect new abilities as you progress, like grenades and forcefields, and upgrade them to devastating effect.

  • Face Towering Bosses

    Every 10 levels, prepare for a brutal boss fight. From a giant skeleton that shatters the ground with shockwaves to a hulking slime that floods the arena with projectiles, each encounter tests your reflexes and tactics.

  • Choose Your Temporary Upgrades

    Between levels, pick from randomized upgrades to adapt your build. Will you focus on raw damage, survivability, or cooldown reduction?

  • Chase the Leaderboards

    The further you go, the higher you climb. Test your skill against players worldwide and fight to secure your spot at the top.

The challenge is simple: how far can you go before the arena finally claims you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
